fusions.name: Barnacled Rake
fusions.desc: Rakes the target with reef-crusted claws for 12 damage, leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and sets it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Brittle Spray
fusions.desc: Tears loose reef growth from your hide and flings 3 shards in a spread, each dealing 5 damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

fusions.name: Reef Den
fusions.desc: Grows a reef den where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Accreting Crust
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, the reef on you grows a stack, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
